en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a studio photograph of six women in elaborate traditional folk costumes with heavy jewelry and head coverings. They are posed around household objects such as large clay jars and baskets. French text on the card identifies it as a souvenir from Salonique (Thessaloniki) and labels the scene as a group of women. There is cursive handwriting in French on the right and bottom margins.
